collection: 512 fresh baseline MCTS640-simulation games. Independent reservoir in4 max-rank bands plus last failure state. Both successes and failures.
teacher: Full4ply expectimax, all chance outcomes, no node cutoff; same frozen value leaves. More exhaustive labels than one-step prior; superiority over MCTS640 not assumed.
split: (sourceSeed-11410001)%5==0 validation; all D4 augmentation stays within source game
training: Policy-only context32ReLU network; teacher softmax(Q4/2000), residual logits added to frozen baseQ/2000; KL loss only, no value loss or value updates. Adam.001, batch16,50epochs, D4 augmentation. Checkpoint lowest validationKL including epoch0.
inference: Root policy prior only, every actual move. All values and internal-node priors remain original. No network corrections at1536+. Root inference inside time budget.
evaluation: baseline and3 models,512 shared fresh games each; original MCTS1msCPU/move, stop1536/death
statistics: Single primary contrast: mean3 trained replicas minus baseline, cluster by512 game seeds, paired t95%CI/test conditional on3 training seeds. No winner picked from game results.
promotion: Research checkpoint delivery; no automatic website update without stable advantage and browser/later-stage validation.
